summary: Light steel tower in Unorganized South Nipissing; 1963 map shows a 24 m tower; ladder removed and demolition recommended by 1985.

facts.agency: Ontario Department of Lands and Forests
facts.status_note: Recommended for demolition in 1985; the register does not describe the site since.

events.note: Shown as an 80 foot steel tower on the Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963)

evidence.supports: Location in Unorganized South Nipissing, Nipissing District
evidence.quote: Unorganized South Nipissing, Nipissing District, Northeastern Ontario, Ontario, Canada

evidence.supports: Elevation of the site is 426 m (1398 ft)
Light steel; lower ladder removed by 1985; recommended for demolition in 1985
evidence.quote: Light steel; lower ladder removed as of 1985; recommended (1985) for demolition.

evidence.supports: Tower no longer appears on the North Bay topographic map 31L
evidence.quote: The tower no longer appears on North Bay topographic map (31L)

evidence.supports: 1963 Department of Lands and Forests map shows an 80 foot steel tower at the site
evidence.quote: the Department of Lands and Forests Tower Detection System Map (1963) shows an 80 foot steel tower at this location.

evidence.supports: Most Ontario towers were erected between the 1920s and the 1950s
evidence.quote: Most of the towers were erected between the 1920's and the 1950's when forest fire protection was in it's heyday.

notes_for_editor: One tower-specific source only: a volunteer register entry crediting Robert Eno and Dave Fluri. No build year. The 426 m figure is the register's elevation, not tower height. The 80 ft height is as the 1963 map is quoted, so height_m is approximate. No later record of the tower was found; current status and access are unverified.
